children: Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. closed the first tranche of its private placement, raising $420.985K versus a planned maximum of $1.1M. The tranche issued 3,827,136 units at $0.11 each; proceeds will support El Potrero project evaluations and working capital.
First tranche raised $420.985K; target up to $1.1M
The company has raised about 38% of the planned maximum; additional closings are needed to reach the target.
The financing adds shares and warrants, creating dilution; each unit includes half a warrant exercisable at $0.16 for 24 months.
Insider participation aligns management with the financing, but represents a related-party transaction.
Proceeds to fund project evaluations and working capital
Funds support El Potrero advancement, though the release gives no quantified work program or timeline.

This is an early-stage financing update for the company's El Potrero project, not a production or exploration-results milestone. Further placement closings and project evaluation outcomes would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
